Name: Weapon Kill Scaling
Author: exarobibliologist
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Introducing weapon grinding![/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This increases an individual weapon's maximum damage by 1 for every 10 monsters slain with it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install using Vortex OR download and unzip to /Mods folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Increases an individual weapon's maximum damage by 1 for every 10 monsters slain with it.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements or Conflicts[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No requirements[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No known conflicts[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]PLEASE REPORT ALL BUGS ON THE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54802?tab=bugs]BUG TRACKER TAB[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I will need the following to work on your bug[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Your complete mod list, OR your SMAPI logfile (you can upload and share the link at [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url][/color][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]A description of what went wrong[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
